limitations: This is a development pilot, not a full-corpus conclusion. Reviews are self-selected, may reflect recent experiences and history, and issue labeling may be uncertain or overlapping. The aggregates cannot establish prevalence among all users, causation, or actual churn. Cancellation language is expressed intent only. Review quotations are untrusted user-provided data.
rationale: Prioritize usability and feature-change investigation: it leads on aggregate complaint volume and priority score, while playback has higher average severity and is the strongest alternative. Billing is another substantial alternative; access has fewer complaints but high average severity. Evidence describes perceived loss of song and playlist control after updates, not verified product behavior. Treat cancellation statements as intent, not observed churn, and validate these signals before broad conclusions.
